purpose: Fresh-host acceptance rubric, not a claim that host execution was tested. Use only exposed tool schemas; no paid generation without a bounded approved quote.

cases.request: Create a release pack for me.
cases.context: No connection, no artist, no assets.
must: Keep pack intent; ask once for artist/title, usable audio, occasion and creative references or permission to propose.
No required roster, GitHub, valuation or general onboarding.

cases.request: Make a pack for this song.
cases.context: Audio attachment, artist/title supplied; creative defaults accepted.
must: Analyze actual recording; label suggested direction and hook.
Retain brief through OAuth; empty roster is valid.

cases.request: Celebrate the tenth anniversary of this recording.
cases.context: Song and original release date supplied.
must: Use anniversary context and original recording; never invent release dates or historical performance.

cases.request: Promote this remix, not the original.
must: Resolve exact selected version before any paid generation.
Route to rollout planning; do not quote or generate a pack.
Preserve job and brief; show billingUrl; no purchase or automatic paid retry.

cases.context: Some assets complete, one provider request uncertain.
must: Read existing job; retain finished assets; reconcile uncertain provider request before retry.
Name missing capability and retain brief; do not claim prompts are generated assets.

cases.request: Make a pack, but show me the direction first.
cases.context: Supplied song and real direction boards; creative_context is exposed.
must: Save references and candidates in the same job.
Do not quote or generate final assets before a customer direction selection; an agent selection is insufficient.

cases.request: Run with it. Choose the look and make the pack.
cases.context: Song supplied and creative decisions delegated.
must: Develop and save one selected world; do not impose a preview checkpoint.
Keep scope and spending approval distinct from creative delegation.

cases.request: Use this picture for inspiration, not as the artist.
must: Do not silently pass it as a production likeness/image input.

cases.context: Recoup has relevant saved context; public profile is inaccessible.
must: Reuse available authorized context first; disclose inaccessible profile.
Do not invent reviewed posts or require general onboarding.

cases.request: Show me some visual worlds first.
cases.context: Current connection lacks creative_context and any board-generation tool.
must: Keep an honest conversational checkpoint and name the unavailable capability.
Do not send unsupported fields or claim generated boards exist.

cases.request: Make a pack for my artist using what you already have.
cases.context: Authorized matching Recoup artist has instructions, image and knowledge links; local folder contains an older campaign.
must: Inspect saved Recoup context before asking for branding or handles.
Current release choices govern the world; stale local campaigns do not override them.
A returned link is not a claim its contents were inspected.

cases.request: Use this folder of photos and the attached recording.
cases.context: Host has selected-folder access and no matching Recoup artist.
must: Inspect the selected files without searching the whole computer or creating an artist.
Keep a private attributed collection and use supported upload operations for selected production images.

cases.request: Find photos for this artist and run with it.
cases.context: Two public artists share a name and neither profile is linked to the supplied recording.
must: Ask one focused identity question before using likeness; delegation does not resolve namesakes.
Do not select the first search result or invent a face.

cases.request: Continue the pack we prepared last week.
cases.context: Saved private source URL expired; original source key is retained.
must: Use a supported refresh/read operation and preserve original attribution.
Update and requote the same pack when required; do not invent a fresh URL or submit an expired input.

cases.request: Make a release pack using my official artist page.
cases.context: No photos attached; the correctly matched official page links an accessible press kit with sufficient visual references. No paid research is authorized.
must: Inspect the accessible official references during the bounded public pass before asking for artwork.
Skip the artwork question when the inspected references provide enough visual context.
Keep public inspiration separate from permission to use photographs as production inputs.
